title: BENCHMARKING ETHICAL AND SAFETY RISKS OF HEALTHCARE LLMS IN CHINA – TOWARD SYSTEMIC GOVERNANCE UNDER HEALTHY CHINA 2030
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith/religion. The benchmark focuses on 11 medical ethics dimensions (e.g., patient privacy, informed consent, fairness) and 9 patient safety dimensions (e.g., clinical accuracy, medication safety, hallucination control).
findings: The paper does not report any findings related to religion.
